description: Discover movies with advanced filters including genre, language, year range, rating, and sorting. Perfect for finding movies that match specific criteria like 'Japanese sci-fi movies from 2020 onwards with rating above 7' or 'Korean dramas with high ratings'.

max_year.description: Maximum release year (e.g., 2023 for movies up to 2023)

min_vote_count.description: Minimum number of votes (helps filter reliable ratings)

min_year.description: Minimum release year (e.g., 2020 for movies from 2020 onwards)

sort_by.description: Sort order (popularity.desc, popularity.asc, vote_average.desc, vote_average.asc, release_date.desc, release_date.asc)

with_original_language.description: Filter by original language using ISO 639-1 codes. Single language (e.g., 'ja') or comma-separated for multiple (e.g., 'ja,ko,zh')

name: discover_movies
